datetime.$comment: The datetime field: its two texts, its button and its dialog. The calendar and the columns inside the dialog keep their own tiers, `--pct-date-*` and `--pct-time-*`, so a theme that restyles them restyles them here too — the point of borrowing them; `--pct-{component}-…` names the ENTRYPOINT (req-token-names, check-tokens point 3; 0090 §6).

fg.$description: Text colour of the datetime field.

border.$description: Edge colour of the datetime field.

border-hover.$description: Edge colour of the datetime field on hover.

border-focus.$description: Edge colour of the datetime field when focused.

border-invalid.$description: Edge colour of the datetime field when invalid.

fg-invalid.$description: Text colour of the datetime field when invalid.

border-warning.$description: Edge colour of the datetime field under a warning (0087).

fg-warning.$description: Text colour of the warning line (0087).

bg-disabled.$description: Background of the datetime field while disabled.

fg-disabled.$description: Text colour of the datetime field while disabled.

border-disabled.$description: Edge colour of the datetime field while disabled.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the datetime field.

font-size.$description: Font size of the datetime field.

font-size-sm.$description: Font size of the datetime field at size sm.

font-size-lg.$description: Font size of the datetime field at size lg.

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of the datetime field.

padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding of the datetime field.

padding-y-sm.$description: Vertical padding of the datetime field at size sm.

padding-x-sm.$description: Horizontal padding of the datetime field at size sm.

padding-y-lg.$description: Vertical padding of the datetime field at size lg.

padding-x-lg.$description: Horizontal padding of the datetime field at size lg.

target-min.$description: Touch-target floor of the datetime field.

toggle-size.$description: Size of the button that opens the panel.

toggle-radius.$description: Corner radius of the button that opens the panel.

toggle-fg.$description: Text colour of the button that opens the panel.

toggle-bg-hover.$description: Background of the button that opens the panel on hover.

panel-gap.$description: Gap between the calendar and the columns in the panel.
